民生年鑑 1940

Minsei nenkan (Welfare Yearbook), 第4次 (4th issue), covering 康德7年 (1940)
滿洲帝國民生部 (Manchukuo Ministry of People's Welfare), 新京, 康德10年7月 (July 1943); printed by 東亞印書局

Every table in both parts and the appendix is transcribed; the narrative prose and organisation charts of the first part are not. The statistics were printed as numbered sheets (第一表ノ一, ノ二 …), often one table across both pages of a spread with the row labels only on the left page; each sheet is given as one part of its table, the right-page figures matched to the left-page row labels by order and row counts. Where a sheet begins in the middle of a province, the province name is supplied from the previous sheet and noted. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops of each page. The scan is a 1940s print on poor paper with worn and broken type: commas and decimal points are hard to tell apart, and 1,146 of about 79,000 filled cells (1.5%) could not be read with confidence and are marked [?]. Printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted in each table (there are many misprints); where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Cells printed as “?” in the original are kept as ?. The scan has page 106 twice (frames 65 and 66; frame 65 is a darker duplicate).
